title: IndiaSkills National Competition 2025-26 - Digital & ICT Skills
description: IndiaSkills is the country's premier biennial skill competition organized by NSDC and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE). Competitors compete in emerging technologies including Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Web Technologies, and Mobile Applications Development to qualify for Team India at WorldSkills 2026 in Shanghai.
location: Regional & National Skill Centers (Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Kolkata)
prize_pool: Gold, Silver, Bronze Medals, Cash Prizes & Represent Team India at WorldSkills 2026

eligibility_criteria.notes: Must be born on or after 1 January 2002 as per WorldSkills international eligibility norms.

title: IndiaSkills 2025-26 - Industry 4.0 & Advanced Manufacturing
description: National vocational engineering challenge focusing on Industry 4.0 technologies, Autonomous Mobile Robotics, Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing), and Mechanical Engineering CAD. Organized by WorldSkills India under MSDE.
location: Designated WorldSkills India Nodal Centers Across India
prize_pool: National Skill Medals, Industry Apprenticeships & WorldSkills 2026 Qualifier

eligibility_criteria.notes: Participants must demonstrate hands-on hardware prototype or CAD/CAM assembly.

title: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) Innovation Challenge
organizer: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
description: Nationwide digital challenge hosted under Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) for young developers, vocational trainees, and technical students to design solutions for digital credentialing, localized skills assessment, and apprenticeship matching.
prize_pool: Certificates of National Excellence, MSDE Incubation Grants & Felicitations

eligibility_criteria.notes: Registered user profile on Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) required for submission.
